# v0.1.1 — Package build fix

2026-09-08 (UTC) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/yyyz1011/sheetdelta/releases/tag/v0.1.1)

## Changes

Build distribution files before packing the npm package.

## Installation and upgrade

Install this version:

```sh

```

Review the [migration guide](../migration) and [related usage guide](../quick-start) before upgrading. This is a summary of released changes, not a claim of support for every Excel feature.
